profile.summary: A Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business founded in 2008 that helps medical product makers sell to Veterans Affairs and Department of Defense medical facilities, distributing items such as spine implants, orthopedic devices and wound care products. It also offered COVID-19 testing and vaccination programs to governments, K-12 schools and universities.
